topic.title: Introduction to Container Isolation
topic.shortdesc: An overview of container isolation techniques for secure workload execution.

body.p: Container isolation is a fundamental building block for running untrusted or semi-trusted workloads in a shared environment. By combining Linux namespaces, cgroups, and seccomp-BPF filters, operators can restrict what a process can see and do.

section.title: Why Isolation Matters
section.p: Without proper isolation, a compromised process can:

ul.li: Access host filesystems and sensitive data.
